Name: Databricks
Author: David Broggy - david.broggy@levelblue.com
Description:
The [Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests the account and workspace [audit logs](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/account-settings/audit-logs) that Databricks on AWS delivers to Amazon S3, using the Codeless Connector Framework S3 poller. No Function App or AWS access keys are needed.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

a. [Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

**Pre-requisites:**

1. Databricks Premium or Enterprise tier with audit log delivery to S3 (JSON).

2. Rights to deploy the solution's two CloudFormation templates and add an S3 event notification.
